cases.situation: My friend Nadia's dad died two weeks ago. I went to the funeral but haven't messaged since because I don't know what to say. She's been quiet.
cases.reply: Hey Nadia, I've been thinking about you and your dad a lot this week. No need to reply to this. I'm going to the farmers' market Saturday morning and would love to drop off some of those peaches you like, around 11. Just say no if you'd rather not have company.
cases.note: Why you're writing in one line, no question that needs a report, one concrete offer with a time, and a release.

cases.situation: 大学室友小林研究生没考上，已经一个多星期没在群里说话了。我私聊问她还好吗，她就回了一句'挺好的'。
cases.reply: 好，我信你。不过如果哪天不太好了，半夜两点也可以直接找我，不用理由。周六我去你们学校附近那家火锅店，你想来就来，不想说话光吃也行。
cases.note: 第一次说'挺好的'就先接住，不追问，把门留着，再给一个具体、可以轻松拒绝的邀约。

cases.situation: My coworker Mark has been on sick leave for cancer treatment for two months. We're not super close but I liked working with him. I texted once a month ago, no reply.
cases.reply: Hi Mark, the team was talking about your terrible pun in the March all-hands today and it made me think of you. No need to reply. Just wanted you to know you're missed around here.
cases.note: After silence, send something that needs zero response and never mention the unanswered text.

cases.situation: Mi amiga Carmen perdió el trabajo hace un mes. Le escribí varias veces ofreciéndole ayuda con el currículum y hoy me contestó: 'deja de tratarme como un proyecto'.
cases.reply: Tienes razón, me pasé de insistente. Me echo para atrás. La oferta no caduca y aquí sigo, sin prisa y sin preguntas.
cases.note: No defiendas tu intención. Cumple lo que dices y reaparece en un par de semanas con algo pequeño que no tenga nada que ver con el trabajo.

cases.situation: 妈妈走了半年，爸爸一个人住在老家。每次打电话他都说'挺好的，你别操心'，但邻居说他最近很少出门。国庆我能回去几天。
cases.reply: 爸，我10月2号下午到家，待到6号。这几天你别做饭，我带你去老街吃那家羊肉粉，再陪你去河边钓两天鱼。你什么都不用准备。平时想说说话了，随时打给我，不用找理由。
cases.note: 他说'挺好的'就先接受，不追问；直接给一个带日期的具体安排，再留一扇门。

cases.situation: I manage a small team. My report Priyanka told me briefly that her mum went into hospice last week. She's still logging on every day and says she's fine. I want to check in without making her feel watched.
cases.reply: Priyanka, I'm thinking of you and your mum this week. No need to reply to this. I've moved the Kessler report to October 16 and Jamal is covering Thursday's client call, so both are off your plate. If you want to take days, just tell me which ones; you don't need to explain.
cases.note: From a manager the most useful concrete help is taking work away, done already, not offered. No questions she has to answer.

cases.situation: My friend Leo texted me at 1am 'honestly I don't see the point of any of it anymore' and then nothing. He lost his job in August and his girlfriend moved out last month. We're both in Chicago, he's 20 minutes from me.
cases.reply: Leo, I'm really glad you told me. I'm worried about you and I'd rather ask than wonder: are you thinking about ending your life? Whatever the answer is, you can tell me. I'm awake, and I can be at yours in 20 minutes, or stay on the phone with you while you call or text 988. Reply with anything and I'll call you straight away.
cases.note: Ask directly; it does not plant the idea. If he says yes, or you can't reach him and fear for his life, call 911. That one is not yours to carry alone.

cases.situation: 好朋友阿敏生完孩子两个多月，朋友圈好久没更新。上次视频她一直哭，说没睡过一个整觉。我们住同一个城市，我想帮点实际的忙。
cases.reply: 阿敏，这几天一直惦记你，不用回我。周六上午10点我过去帮你抱两个小时娃，你去睡一觉，午饭我从你楼下那家粥铺带上来。不方便的话回个“改天”就行，一点不用客气。
cases.note: 不问“你还好吗”，只给一个带时间、容易接受也容易拒绝的具体帮忙。

cases.situation: My friend Carla told me three weeks ago that she and her husband are divorcing. A week later I texted offering to bring dinner over, and she never replied. I don't want to pester her, but I don't want her to think I've disappeared.
cases.reply: Walked past Luca's this morning and thought of you and our Friday pizza nights. No need to reply, just still here and thinking of you.
cases.note: After silence, send something that needs zero response and never mention the unanswered text. About once a week, not more.

cases.situation: My friend Tom went quiet for about a month after his startup shut down. I've sent a couple of low-key texts. He just replied: 'sorry I've been a ghost, honestly things are pretty bad right now.' I don't want to blow this.
cases.reply: No sorry needed, I'm really glad you told me. Can I call you tonight around 8? If talking feels like too much, just reply 'text' and we'll do it this way instead.
cases.note: When they finally open up, show up fast and small: no advice, no questions that need a report, one concrete offer with an easy way to shrink it.

cases.situation: 好朋友小雅上周流产了，是她老公告诉我的。她在上海，我在北京，一时过不去。她只在朋友圈发了一句“晚安”，别的什么都没说。
cases.reply: 小雅，听说了上周的事，心里很难受，一直在想你。不用回我。我给你点了明天中午的外卖，是你喜欢的那家云南米线，12点左右送到，不想吃就放着。我一直都在。
cases.note: 不问“你还好吗”，不找安慰的角度，只给一个不需要回应的具体行动；过几天再发一条不需要回复的消息。
